description:
CCPM Team 6 is dedicated to tackling NASA’s challenge of advancing fire safety by exploring how combustion behaves in microgravity and applying these discoveries to improve fire safety in space and on Earth.

Through SIMPLYFIRE, our AI-powered dashboard, we aim to organize, analyze, and interpret NASA’s combustion research, turning complex scientific data into accessible insights.

We believe understanding fire beyond Earth can help create a safer future everywhere.
